## Why

S31 (2026-10-26, owner screenshots): the S78 engine run ork-20261025-175709-e8c9 is awaiting-approval in the daemon (ork status --json), but slicer marked its ledger run run-20261025-175710-49a6 stale after hours without updates. Overview's Approve row reads '+ ork-20261025-175709-e8c9  S78  stale  owner approval  23m': dimmed like a dead run, the word stale, and an age frozen at 23m although it has waited about 19 h. Selecting it shows only the summary strip. The owner cannot tell it is still approvable. The ledger heartbeat (S70) stops while the engine waits for the owner, so every approval that waits more than slicer's stale threshold looks dead.
